point.plan:
Federated
 Projection: orders.id, orders.value, orders.label
  Filter: orders.id = Int64(43)
    TableScan: orders projection=[id, value, label]

aggregate.plan:
Federated
 Sort: orders.label ASC NULLS LAST
  Projection: orders.label, count(Int64(1)) AS n, sum(orders.value) AS total
    Aggregate: groupBy=[[orders.label]], aggr=[[count(Int64(1)), sum(orders.value)]]
      TableScan: orders projection=[value, label]

join.plan:
Federated
 Sort: l.id ASC NULLS LAST
  Projection: l.id, l.value, r.label
    Inner Join:  Filter: l.id = r.id
      Filter: l.id BETWEEN Int64(10) AND Int64(20)
        SubqueryAlias: l
          TableScan: orders projection=[id, value]
      SubqueryAlias: r
        TableScan: other_orders projection=[id, label]

topk.plan:
Federated
 Limit: skip=5, fetch=10
  Sort: orders.value DESC NULLS FIRST, orders.id ASC NULLS LAST
    Projection: orders.id, orders.value
      Filter: orders.value IS NOT NULL
        TableScan: orders projection=[id, value]

nulls.plan:
Federated
 Projection: count(Int64(1)) AS n, count(orders.value) AS nonnull, sum(orders.value) AS total
  Aggregate: groupBy=[[]], aggr=[[count(Int64(1)), count(orders.value), sum(orders.value)]]
    TableScan: orders projection=[value]
